function.arguments: {"index": 5, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The key issue is that the email campaign was not randomly assigned — it was targeted at loyal customers, who are more likely to convert. This creates confounding: channel and customer_segment are correlated, so a raw comparison of conversion rates between channels is biased. To estimate the causal effect of the campaign, we must adjust for customer_segment. We used standardization (population adjustment) to compute the difference in conversion rates under a common segment distribution. The standardized difference (email minus paid_search) is -0.1279, which is the correct adjusted effect. This method accounts for the confounding and provides an unbiased estimate of the campaign's effect."}
function.name: resolve_finding
